description: This file defines the TransactionalResourceExtension class, which implements ITransactionalResourceExtension. It manages transactional resources, providing methods for commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations, and maintains a registry of resources.

classes.name: TransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: Implements ITransactionalResourceExtension, manages transactional resources, and provides methods for transaction operations.

methods.name: TransactionalResourceExtension
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resource factories and resource dictionary using the provided context accessor.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Commits a read-only transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the transaction with a given status on the specified resource.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms the transaction on the specified resource.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the specified resource for a transaction.

methods.name: GetResource
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a transactional resource by resourceId.
